name: weave-pair
description: Two panes side by side: comparison, code and explanation, or editor + preview.
provenPattern: From the compatibility matrix: the looms this arrangement is legal on were determined from measured page spines.

knowledge.purpose: The spine where two things must be seen at once
antiPatterns: Leaving one pane much narrower than the other — both panes share the row equally
Not saying which pane comes first on a narrow screen — the first pane is the one read first
Filling only one pane — with one thing to show this is a single column, not a pair

mobileCollapse: Vertical stack — the first pane comes first, the second under it; the order is the order the panes are filled.

placeholders.{{BANDS}}: the panes: the first empty region takes the first pane bands (read first on a phone), the second region the second pane bands
